entry.name: jit.movie~
entry.digest: Play a movie file with an audio track
entry.description: Use jit.movie~ for playing movie files and routing the audio track into MSP.

attributes.name: adapt
attributes.digest: Adapt output matrix dimensions to movie size flag

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: automatic
attributes.description: Enable automatic matrix output when bound to.

attributes.name: autostart
attributes.description: Autoplay on movie open flag (default = 1)

attributes.name: background
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: cache_size
attributes.digest: The maximum cache size in gigabytes
attributes.description: The maximum cache size in gigabytes (default = 0.1). The cache stores frames in memory as they are decoded, allowing for efficient playback. When the cache_size limit is reached, the least recently used frames are discarded from the cache.Reverse playback stutters may be the result of insufficient cache_size.Care should be taken when adjusting the cache_size, if the frame cache exceeds the available memory, the application may crash.See themessage for loading a file into cache automatically.

attributes.name: color
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: colormode
attributes.description: The output matrix's color encoding.

attributes.name: drawto
attributes.description: A render context name, used whenis enabled.

attributes.name: dstrect
attributes.digest: The portion of the output matrix written to by the input frame
attributes.description: The portion of the output matrix used for decompressing media to the internal matrix (default = 0 0 (matrix width) (matrix height))The bounds of the rectangle are expressed in the form. All values are relative to the top-left corner of the viewing area of the output matrix.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: The duration of the movie.

attributes.name: engine
attributes.description: Video engine backend. This argument can only be set in the max box. If not specified, it is determined by the Video Engine Max preference. As of this writing, possible values include(Mac only),and.

attributes.name: fontface
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: fontname
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: fontsize
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: framecount
attributes.digest: Number of frames in the movie

attributes.name: framereport
attributes.description: Frame reporting flag (default = 0). When enabled, the messagewill be sent from the rightmost outlet of theobject as each frame is processed, followed by the number of milliseconds spent doing so.

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: hint
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: ignoreclick
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: jspainterfile
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: loop
attributes.description: Looping mode (default = 1 (start to end))

choices.digest: 2 = palindrome looping (start to end to start to ....)
3 = no looping, but use looppoints to define playback limits

attributes.name: loopend
attributes.description: The movie loop point end. Time is specified asvalues.

attributes.name: looppoints
attributes.description: The movie loop points. Time is specified asvalues.

attributes.name: loopreport
attributes.description: Loop notification flag (default = 0). When enabled, theobject will send the messagewhen the playing movie passes the loop point. In palindrome looping mode, the message will be sent at both the beginning and the end of the movie.

attributes.name: loopstart
attributes.description: The movie loop point start. Time is specified asvalues.

attributes.name: moviefile
attributes.digest: Load a movie file from disk
attributes.description: Load a movie file from disk

attributes.name: moviename
attributes.description: Identifies the file name of a movie (Note: setting this attribute does not load a movie file).

attributes.name: moviepath
attributes.digest: Fully specified path on disk for the movie
attributes.description: The movie's fully-specified path on disk, if the movie has a disk-file (Note: setting this attribute does not load a movie file).

attributes.name: output_texture
attributes.description: Enable OpenGL texture output (default = 0). When enabled an OpenGL texture is output instead of a Jitter matrix. The object'sattribute must be set to a valid gl context. An RGBA texture is output using the movie's native dimensions. When enabled, the following attributes have no effect:

attributes.name: patching_rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Current playback position, normalized between 0. and 1.

attributes.name: presentation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: presentation_rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: seconds
attributes.description: The movie duration in seconds.

attributes.name: size
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: srcrect
attributes.digest: The portion of the input matrix used when copying an input matrix to the internal matrix
attributes.description: The portion of the movie to decompress into a matrix (default = 0 0 (movie width) (movie height)). The bounds of the rectangle are expressed in the form. All values are relative to the top-left corner of the viewing area of the movie.

attributes.name: textcolor
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: textjustification
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: texture_name
attributes.description: Output texture name, whenis enabled.

attributes.name: time
attributes.description: The current time in the movie. The actual time in seconds depends on theattribute.

attributes.name: time_secs
attributes.description: Current playback time in seconds. See the above Discussion for information on usingwhen setting this attribute.

attributes.name: timescale
attributes.description: The timescale for the movie (default = 600, but movie-dependent). The timescale determines the number ofunits per second.

attributes.name: unique
attributes.description: Unique frame filter flag (default = 0 (disabled)). When the flag is set, only new frames from the movie are output when the object receives a bang. If no new frame has been decompressed, theobject will not respond to the bang.

attributes.name: usedstrect
attributes.description: Destination rect flag (default = 0). When the flag is set, theattributes are used when copying an input matrix to the internal matrix.

attributes.name: usesrcrect
attributes.description: Source rect flag (default = 0). When the flag is set, theattributes are used when copying an input matrix to the internal matrix.

attributes.name: varname
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

messages.name: asyncread
messages.digest: Read a movie from a disk file asynchronously
messages.description: Asynchronously reads a movie from a disk file in a non-blocking background thread. If no argument is present a file selection dialog will be presented to choose a file.

messages.name: dispose
messages.description: Close the currently loaded movie and free any memory associated with it

messages.name: frame
messages.digest: Jump to a frame number (fast method)
messages.description: Jump to a frame number (fast method).

messages.name: frame_true
messages.digest: Jump to a frame number (slower, more accurate method)
messages.description: Jump to a frame number (slower, more accurate method).

messages.name: jump
messages.digest: Jump to a relative movie frame (fast method)
messages.description: Jump to a relative movie frame (fast method).

messages.name: jump_true
messages.digest: Jump to a relative movie frame (slower, more accurate method)
messages.description: Jump to a relative movie frame (slower, more accurate method).

messages.name: loadram
messages.digest: Load the current movie file into memory
messages.description: loadram will attempt to load the current movie file into memory. The loading happens in a non-blocking background thread. When complete a loadram notification specifying the exact range loaded is sent out the dump outlet.Arguments allow for specifying a range to load, in seconds. A single positive argument specifies end time, A single negative argument specifies start time from the end, and two arguments specify start and end times.Theattribute must be set prior to the loadram request to a value large enough to hold frames from the specified range.When a loadram request is executing the file cannot play back frames until the request is completed or themessage is received.

messages.name: read
messages.digest: Read a movie from a disk file/URL
messages.description: Reads a movie from a disk file or URL. If no argument is present a file selection dialog will be presented to choose a file. If the argument is parseable as a URL, the object will attempt to load a movie from that location. Otherwise, an argument is assumed to be a local file name.Ifis enabled, the movie will begin playing at once.

messages.name: start
messages.description: Starts movie playback at the currentfrom the currentvalue.

messages.name: unloadram
messages.digest: Release any frames loaded with themessage
